cellLimbs.standing: Answered as specified-classes-not-executed for admission/request exclusions and for honesty/disclosure of unprevented trusted-TCB ambient effects. The classes are named at live condition-4 / DR-G* obligations (D-157 / D-158 / D-159). Remainder is execution. This candidate does not claim host confinement of a running first-party component. Prevention of ambient egress is DR-128 post-MVP, not this preview. A future permission-cell enforcement primitive and evidence are DR-105/DR-G09; applying such confinement to approve third-party/untrusted roles additionally requires DR-128 product approval. Not QUALIFIED. Not SATISFIED.

sevenItems.countPin: D-011, seven items. Any change to that enumeration re-opens DR-117.

dispositions.name: marketplace/catalog and governance depth
dispositions.preview: NO. First-party / explicitly trusted components only. No marketplace.

dispositions.name: external lifecycle parity and discovery
dispositions.preview: NO public lifecycle parity. Host-owned one lifecycle for first-party components.

dispositions.name: contribution roles beyond narrow/data-only
dispositions.preview: NO. P-2 narrow producers / data-only remains. Findings stay host-owned (DR-133 / D-136 candidate). Persistence, rendering, termination, and host lifecycle remain host-owned; they are not DR-133's output-law surface.

dispositions.name: untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence
dispositions.preview: NO admission. DR-128 stays post-MVP. DR-G21 is not a sandbox. Demonstrated OS/WASM enforcement, matrix, escape tests, revocation, incident ownership attach to DR-128, not condition 4. Preview enforcement is EE-4.

dispositions.name: imperative contributions, probes, project hooks, and root commands
dispositions.preview: NO as contribution roles. Imperative contributions as a class, contribution-owned probes, project hooks, and contributor-owned root commands remain excluded. Host-owned consented doctor probes remain host acts under D-002 / D-032. No contributor owns a root command. Analyze stays offline.

dispositions.name: network-granted analysis and egress defaults
dispositions.preview: NO. Offline preview. No network-granted analysis default.

dispositions.name: replacement of the full-default G3 physical substrate
dispositions.preview: PARTIAL, recorded: TypeScript is the only preview language role. Default useful install is signed distribution core + semantic host + one selected TypeScript closure + the future DR-131 pack (pack not invented here). Core-only is recovery/management, not the analysis product. rustc_driver sidecar remains the substrate and is deferred as a supported analysis role, not abandoned. D-002 independent-release surface is preserved, not narrowed.

classes.invariant: Component-originated PT-NET-EGRESS under ambient authority is DISCLOSURE-ONLY in the preview. The host neither observes nor prevents the ACT. A refused ASK is not a blocked ACT. This is honesty, not confinement.
